scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry hall, coat closet, stacked-laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user sequentially opens and closes two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, a refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utility drawer.
